    {"id": "F8", "at": 21, "text": "半年前离家出走的南小风遇到了白灵。", "predicate": "P_encounters", "arguments": [{"role": "subject", "value": {"type": "ref", "id": "known:c03:E_fengxinzi"}}, {"role": "object", "value": {"type": "ref", "id": "E_bailing"}}], "polarity": "affirmative", "assertion": {"kind": "world", "holder": null, "opaque": false}, "time": "T_half_year_ago", "quantifier": "particular", "modality": "actual", "conditions": [], "textualConditions": [], "exceptions": [], "identities": ["I_fengxinzi", "I_bailing"], "proof": {"premises": ["D10"], "method": "direct", "certainty": "accepted", "rationale": "D10回顾半年前相遇。"}},
